new_jobs.title: Head of GTMC, HKTW
new_jobs.jd: **About The Job** We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our talented teams work together, revolutionizing treatment, continually improving products, understanding unmet needs, and connecting communities. We chase the miracles of science every single day, pursuing Progress to make a real impact on millions of patients around the world. **Main Responsibilities** **GTMC HKTW setup and transition** * Ensure the successful transition and build-up phase for the new GTMC team in Hong Kong and Taiwan in alignment with the global GTMC strategy & objectives; implement standardized approaches that support business growth * Define and set up Hong Kong and Taiwan GTMC team, which includes integrating of existing capabilities and resources as well as building up/enriching new capabilities * Actively drive the restructuring, refinement, and streamlining of existing activities synergistically across business units * Actively support the centralization of key GTM capabilities at scale in Sanofi Global Hubs with successful transfer of selected activities and integration with advanced Digital technology * Ensure teaming excellence by promoting innovative ways of working through the setup of lean and effective GTMC governance for Greater China team and detailed delineation of interfaces to key functions, such as Digital and hubs **Commercial Capabilities** * Ensure the creation and implementation of a GTMC strategy in Hong Kong and Taiwan that incorporates specific demands and that is in line with the global GTMC strategy & objectives to enhance commercial capabilities locally; especially foster implementation of new cross-GBU programs to maximize the value for One Sanofi * In line with the global GTMC strategy, set up a GTMC team in Hong Kong and Taiwan that: * Helps to drive growth through targeted insights and analytics; increase level of globalization and standardization across GBUs and leverage Global Hubs where helpful to increase efficiency with a strong understanding of the needs and the nuances of each GBU * Supports the delivery of intentional, impactful customer experiences for HCPs and patients through integrated engagements and solutions that enable customer experience to be consistent, seamless and scalable to different market requirements by providing best-in-class methodology consistent across GBUs * Drives the development and implementation of global launch excellence framework and capabilities to ensure holistic best-in-class approach to product launches * Oversees the build of omnichannel solutions that fit the needs of the various GBUs and helps the brands and franchises within the GBUs optimize their approach to customers by fully leveraging the system's capabilities **Strategic Planning and Performance** * Contribute to continuous effectiveness and driving change and upskilling * Set and communicate strategic priorities for GTMC pillars that are in line with the global GTMC strategic priorities and ensure that the objectives are well connected to the priorities of Hong Kong and Taiwan businesses * Oversee resource and budget planning within GTMC aligned with the GBUs in local organization **Ways of working** * The role is a member of the HongKong Taiwan Commercial Leadership Team and closely work with Business Units to ensure best serving business needs, and enabling their Go to Market operations and Transformation * The role is also a member of the Greater China GTMC Leadership Team and work with the global GTMC pillar heads * Foster partnerships and close collaboration between cross-functional teams (GBU, GTMC, Hubs, Digital) and work on institutionalizing ways of working between teams to provide maximum value and efficiency to business teams * Continuously foster collaborative and interactive ways of working with China and other markets to ensure consistency across markets and sharing of best practices & learnings * Build and develop a team that leverages complementary strengths and develop dedicated, strong, and diverse talents through One Sanofi mindset **About You** **Basic qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or related fields * 10+ years of relevant professional business experience, preferred in omnichannel operational marketing in the healthcare/FMCG or relevant industry * Ability to work cross-functionally * Strong strategic marketing, analytical and planning skills * Fluency in English (both written and spoken), mandarin highly welcomed **Leadership Skills** * Strong relationship & Influence: inspiring leadership style with a demonstrated ability to lead and motivate a diverse team * Results orientation: executes, is comfortable with ambiguity, and adapts with agility * Strategic thinking: disrupts status quo with innovation, while remaining pragmatic and focused on priorities * Can drive action across the team and with stakeholders **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in or with global GTMC teams * Commercial Operations knowledge and understanding of key dimensions such as Insight & Analytics, Field Operations, Omnichannel, Marketing Operations, etc. a plus *Pursue progress, discover Extraordinary* *Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.* *At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.* *Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!*

new_jobs.title: Director of Cybersecurity Business Unit
new_jobs.company: 三竹資訊股份有限公司
new_jobs.jd: 我們正在尋找一位具備商業戰略視野與深厚技術底蘊的 **資安事業群主管（Director of Cybersecurity Business Unit）** 。 本事業群背靠集團在金融科技與行動應用領域的龐大客戶基礎（涵蓋各大證券、銀行與企業級客戶），致力於提供跨企業領域的全方位軟硬體資安解決方案與合規防護服務。您將配合公司資安發展方向，全權與董事長統籌事業群的技術研發藍圖、產品商業化（Go-to-Market）與業務拓展策略，帶領團隊打造具備市場競爭力的資安產品線，並對事業群整體營運績效負責。 **【主要職責 / Key Responsibilities】** * **事業群戰略與 P&L 管理** ：制定資安事業群中長期發展藍圖、年度營運目標與預算規劃，驅動營收與獲利持續成長。 * **技術藍圖與產品規劃** ：領導技術與產品團隊，整合軟硬體、網路安全、專利申請等，打造符合法規與企業痛點的解決方案。 * **業務拓展與生態系建立** ：主導大型企業與金融機構之商務談判，建立策略合作夥伴關係（原廠代理、技術聯盟與系統整合商），擴大市場佔有率。 * **跨部門資源整合與團隊領導** ：帶領業務、技術售前（Presales）與研發團隊，建立高效能組織文化，並與集團內其他事業群進行資源綜效整合。 **【任職資格 / Qualifications】** * **資安產業深厚歷練** ：具備 10 年以上資訊安全、網路安全或資訊系統相關經驗，且擁有 5 年以上大型團隊或事業單位（BU）管理經驗（曾任職於資安原廠、MSSP 託管服務商、SI 系統整合商或金融業或政府資安高階主管者尤佳）。 * **軟硬體全棧技術視野** ：熟悉企業網路架構、軟硬體資安防護技術（如防火牆、端點防護、滲透測試、APP 資安檢測、零信任架構、SOC 監控等），能與技術團隊及客戶 CTO/CISO 進行深度對話。 * **卓越的商業敏銳度** ：具備從 0 到 1 打造資安產品或成功推動 B2B 企業級業務增長的實戰業績。 * **合規與法規熟悉度** ：熟悉 ISO 27001、ISMS 及台灣金融監管機構對資安合規之要求，具備協助客戶通過資安稽核之實務經驗。 * **加分條件** ：持有 CISSP、CISM、CISA 等國際高階資安認證。 * **薪酬福利** ：具競爭力之高階主管薪酬結構機制。

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
new_jobs.jd: **Company Introduction** Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door. Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond. We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” **Role Overview** We are seeking a strategic, commercially sharp Senior Manager of Strategic Partnerships to define and build Coupang Taiwan’s external partnership ecosystem. This is a senior, high-impact role: you will set the partnership strategy, own our value proposition to external partners, and personally lead negotiations with C-level and VP-level counterparts across finance, marketing, loyalty coalitions, and other strategic industries. Banking and payment partnerships are a cornerstone of this role, but the mandate is broader — you will identify and explore appropriate partnerships to best accelerate Coupang’s growth in Taiwan. **What You Will Do** **Partnership Strategy** * Define and own the strategic and tactical partnership roadmap for Coupang Taiwan, aligned to company-wide commercial and growth objectives. * Craft Coupang’s external partnership value proposition - why the best banks, payment schemes, loyalty coalitions, telecom, merchants, and ecosystem players should partner with us. * Evaluate new partnership opportunities end-to-end: market mapping, business case, deal structuring, negotiation, and closing. **External Relationships & Deal Leadership** * Own and grow senior-level external relationships, including C-level/VP counterparts at partner financial institutions, telecom providers, and other strategic collaborators. * Lead high-stakes commercial negotiations — including promotion funding, co-marketing investments, exclusive offers, and revenue/GMV-share structures. * Establish partnership frameworks, joint business plans, and governance cadences (QBRs, executive sponsor programs) that turn signed deals into sustained results. **Cross-Functional Leadership** * Partner with leadership across Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations to launch and scale partnership initiatives. * Set the operating model for partnership execution — from monthly bank promotions to flagship strategic alliances — and raise the bar on execution quality. * Mentor and develop junior team members; help build the partnerships function for scale. **What You Will Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; MBA is a plus. * 7-10 years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or corporate development, ideally spanning e-commerce, payments, banking/fintech, or consumer internet. * A proven track record of originating, structuring, and closing strategic partnerships — and turning them into measurable business results. * Executive presence and negotiation skills; comfortable engaging senior external stakeholders and representing Coupang at industry level. * Deep understanding of the payments and banking ecosystem in Taiwan is strongly preferred. * Strategic thinker who is also hands-on — you can define the vision and drive the details. * Native proficiency in Chinese and business- level fluency in English (spoken and written). **Why Join Us** * Build the partnerships function, not just run it: shape the strategy, the team, and the playbook. * Work directly with leadership on deals that meaningfully move Coupang’s growth in Taiwan. * Combine the scale and resources of a global e-commerce leader with the ownership of a build-from-scratch role. **Recruitment Process and Others** **Recruitment Process** Application Review - Job Fit Interview - Focus Interview – Offer The exact nature of the recruitment process may vary according to the specific job and may be changed due to scheduling or other circumstances. Interview schedules and the results will be informed to the applicant via the e-mail address submitted at the application stage. **Details to Consider** This job posting may be closed prior to the stated end date for application if all openings are filled. Coupang has the right to rescind an offer of employment if a candidate is found to have submitted false information as part of the application process. Those eligible for employment protection (recipients of veteran’s benefits, the disabled, etc.) may receive preferential treatment for employment in accordance with applicable laws. **Privacy Notice** Your personal information will be collected and managed by Coupang as stated in the Application Privacy Notice located below: https://www.coupang.jobs/privacy-policy/

new_jobs.title: General Manager, Material Science, Taiwan

diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies. **Job Description** **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Duties** Ability to perform duties commonly associated with Managing Director Material Science China, a similarly situated company, including, but not limited to, the following: * Implementing the decision of the Executive Director, organizing and managing the daily operations of the Company, and submitting management reports to the Executive Director, including all relevant data on the Company's performance against the budget and explanations for all major deviations from the budget, as required by the Executive Director. * Driving Business growth profitably in line with the Company’s direction. * Submitting periodic written reports to the Executive Director on the income and expenditures of the Company together with suggestions for improvement. * Formulating rules and regulations for the operations and management of the Company and personnel, responsibilities and functions of each department, and implementing the same after approval by the Executive Director. * Responsible for the overall operations and management of Company. * Director. * Ability to perform any other duties the Employee may be instructed to carry out by the Employee's manager from time to time that are reasonably within the scope of the Employee's job full P&L responsibility for a business of over 5 M € / Year revenues is preferred. * Management experience of B to B sales in a Material Science domain would be most preferred * Alternatively, sales in a growth-oriented business * Strong experience in identification of merger & acquisition targets, as well as business integration * Science / Engineering Oriented Entrepreneurial Spirit * Strong financial acumen * People leadership * Ambitious * Self-starter

new_jobs.title: Operations Manager, Clinical Research
new_jobs.jd: Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland. We understand what clinical study sites need and our overall mission is to support sites in stronger study delivery. **Job Description** The Manager Operations is responsible for overseeing the operational conduct of clinical trials at contracted medical institutions within a defined country or region in accordance with Milestone One contractual obligations. The Manager Operations provides leadership to Lead Site Coordinators and Site Coordinators, serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for operational issues. This position plays a key role in staff development, process improvement, and continuous operational excellence. SCOPE OF RESPONSIBILITIES * Assesses feasibility of research protocols by reviewing clinical, operational, and resource requirements and recommending suitable trials for the medical institution. * Monitors the progress of budget negotiations and study activation timelines to support timely site readiness. * Manages the team of (Lead) Study Coordinators, oversees the quality and results of their work by monitoring and follow-up of study related reports, timesheets, site trackers and other operational tools to ensure satisfactory performance of the Milestone One team. * Drives process improvement and standardization of clinical trial operations in alignment with ICH GCP, regulatory requirements, MO1 Controlled Documents, by contributing to the development of operational guidelines, templates, and procedures. * Creates a work culture environment that promotes process transparency, accountability, and continuous learning. **Qualifications** * Associate degree in life sciences or similiar. Business Management degree or certification is a plus. * Certifications ICH GCP Training * Minimum 5 years of clinical on the job experience, in a leadership position at a clinical research facility or Network experience is highly preferred. * Knowledgeable and direct experience in the full life cycle of clinical research activities from pre-award through close out. * Fluent use of English * Proficiency in MS Office * Valid category B driver’s license * Excellent communications skills * Excellent management skills, experience managing remote staff preferred. * Effective problem solving and result oriented * Accountable * Team leadership skills **Additional Information** If you want to join a developing company where people matter, you're independent and accountable, Milestone One is the right place for you.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Science, SMAI
new_jobs.jd: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for *all* .** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. SMAI is looking for a Sr. Manager, Data Science to lead a team of about 20 data scientists and data science managers. The team builds the analytics, machine learning and agentic-AI solutions that our yield, process integration, photo and TD engineers use every day, and directly supports the DRAM and HBM yield ramps with AI solutions and hands-on data science. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will set the technical direction, develop the managers and data scientists on the team, and be the person engineering leaders turn to when they need AI to move a yield or output number. **What The Team Is Working On** * Agentic AI for engineering diagnostics: LLM agents, MCPs and skills, built on our BKMs, that turn multi-tool engineering workflows into a single conversation. * Photolithography and process control: ML and analytics for overlay, R2R control, scanner defense line and photo max-out. * Yield ramp acceleration for new technologies: Data science embedded with TD and manufacturing to support yield ramps. * Image analytics and inline detection: Computer vision on inspection and SEM images to shift detection left. * Yield diagnostics and prediction: Tools that connect electrical fails to physical root causes. * Equipment and tool-matching analytics: Raising tool availability and reducing tool-to-tool variation. **What You Will Do** * Lead and grow the team. Set objectives, allocate resources across projects, and coach managers and individual contributors on their technical and career growth. * Own the technical direction. Define the data science roadmap and the team's technical standards, and keep the team at the leading edge of deep learning and generative AI. * Drive manufacturing impact. Turn yield-ramp and output problems into well-scoped data science projects with clear NPV, and drive them through to deployment. * Partner across the network. Work with PIE, PEE, photo SEAL and global sites on priorities and roadmaps, and present results to leadership. * Build talent. Hire, develop and retain strong data scientists, and build a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing and ownership of results. **What You Bring** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8+ years in data science and machine learning, with a track record of shipping ML or AI solutions into production that delivered measurable business impact. * Proven first-level people leadership: you have directly managed data scientists or engineers, including hiring, performance management and development. * Strong, up-to-date expertise in deep learning and generative AI, with solid foundations in statistics, data engineering and MLOps. * A strong desire to improve semiconductor manufacturing performance, and the curiosity to learn the process, equipment and technology behind the data. * The ability to align cross-functional teams behind a common goal. * Experience in yield enhancement, defect, probe, metrology, photolithography or process control is a plus.
